sloka: गुणान् गुणवतो देव देवकल्पस्य धीमतः ।प्रियानानन्ददान् कृत्स्नान् प्रवक्ष्यामोऽद्यतान् शृणु ॥२-२-२७॥
transliteration: guṇān guṇavato deva devakalpasya dhīmataḥ ।priyānānandadān kṛtsnān pravakṣyāmo'dyatān śṛṇu ॥2-2-27॥

translations.english: O king, we shall now speak about those great virtues of the sagacious (Rama). Comparable to those of the gods, they are dear and a source of delight for every one. Please listen.
